title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Entry Requirements: Base Contract and Property
content:
Each rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons can attach only to certain kinds of base contract and, for most riders, only to a property with certain features. The requirements below are the published entry requirements of each rider.

## Base contract requirements

| Rider | Homeowner service contract | Rental property service contract | Real estate contract (buyer phase) | Base tier must cover the kitchen refrigerator | Base tier must cover both systems and appliances |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Septic System Rider | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Bridgewell Well Pump Rider | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider | Yes | No | Yes | No | Yes |

## Property requirements

| Rider | Private well water source | Private septic system | In-ground or above-ground pool or spa | Pool or spa equipment in operating condition on the add date | Roof types accepted | Only leaks over occupied living areas covered | Roof attestation required | Maximum guest unit living area (sq ft) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider | No | No | No | No | none | No | No | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bridgewell Septic System Rider | No | Yes | No | No | none | No | No | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bridgewell Well Pump Rider | Yes | No | No | No | none | No | No | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider | No | No | No | No | asphalt shingle, wood shake, composition, tile | Yes | Yes | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider | No | No | Yes | Yes | none | No | No | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider | No | No | Yes | Yes | none | No | No | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider | No | No | No | No | none | No | No | 750 |

The roof attestation is the customer's attestation, when adding the rider, that the roof is free of known leaks and damage.

## Entry gate of each rider

- **Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider**: the base contract must cover the kitchen refrigerator, and the second refrigerator is inside the home or in an attached garage.
- **Bridgewell Septic System Rider**: the property's sewer type is a private septic system.
- **Bridgewell Well Pump Rider**: the property's water source is a private well.
- **Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider**: the roof is asphalt shingle, wood shake, composition or tile, and the roof condition has been attested.
- **Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider**: the property has a pool only (no spa), and the pool is in operating condition.
- **Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider**: the property has a pool and a spa, or a spa only, and the equipment is in operating condition.
- **Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider**: the guest unit is no larger than 750 square feet, and the base contract is a combination tier covering both systems and appliances.

## Points of reference

**Which rider cannot attach to a rental property service contract?** The Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider.

**A property has both a pool and a spa. Which pool rider matches its configuration?** The Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider, whose entry gate accepts a pool and spa or a spa only; the Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider accepts a pool only.

**Hypothetical guest unit sizes.** A guest unit of 750 square feet meets the Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider's size requirement; one of 751 square feet does not.
